mcp_add_existing_empty: Every Server in this Account is already added to this Agent. Create a new one instead.
mcp_attach_failed: Couldn’t add this Server. Try again.
mcp_authorize_bearer_description: Paste the key this Server expects. It is sent in the header below and stored encrypted; it is never shown again.
mcp_authorize_dialog_description: Choose how this Agent authorizes with this Server. Other Agents may use a different method on the same Server.
mcp_authorize_failed: Couldn’t start the authorization. Try again.
mcp_authorize_none_description: No credential is sent. Choose this for a Server that needs none.
mcp_authorize_oauth_description: You will be sent to the Server’s authorization server and returned here when you approve.
mcp_create_description: A Server definition is shared by every Agent that adds it and holds no credential. Creating one also adds it to this Agent; authorize it in the next step.
mcp_create_failed: Couldn’t create this Server. Check the URL and name, then try again.
mcp_default_auth_help: Only a prefill for a new authorization. It does not restrict how any Agent authorizes with this Server.
mcp_description_edit_help: Leave empty to show the discovered description. What you write here takes precedence.
mcp_detach_and_delete_description: Removes it from every Agent and deletes the definition. Available only when no other Agent uses it.
mcp_detach_and_delete_label: Remove and delete the Server definition
mcp_detach_only_description: The definition stays in the Account and can be added again later.
mcp_disabled_authorization_required_hint: Disabled. Authorization is required to use its tools.
mcp_discovery_failed_hint: Tools couldn’t be loaded. Try refreshing.
mcp_edit_auth_scheme_help: Leave the scheme empty to send the stored value exactly as it is, with no prefix.
mcp_edit_failed: Couldn’t save these settings. Try again.
mcp_edit_scope_agent_description: Replaces this Agent’s overrides. No other Agent is affected.
mcp_empty: No MCP Servers added yet. Add one to give this Agent tools from an external Server.
mcp_intro: Connect MCP servers to give this Agent access to external tools and services.
mcp_name_help: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Used in commands.
mcp_probe_failed: Couldn’t discover the tools. Check the URL and credential, then try again.
mcp_remove_failed: Couldn’t remove this Server. Try again.
mcp_revoke_description: The credential is deleted. The Server stays added, and you can authorize it again.
mcp_revoke_failed: Couldn’t revoke the authorization. Try again.
mcp_tools_empty: This Server reported no tools for this Agent’s credential.
mcp_tools_title: Tools discovered with this Agent’s credential
mcp_tools_truncated: The list was truncated; this is not the Server’s complete tool set.
